## Required controls

- [ ] Qualified supervision assigned.
- [ ] Emergency stop process reviewed.
- [ ] PPE confirmed.
- [ ] Ventilation or extraction confirmed.
- [ ] Participant boundary defined.
- [ ] Dry run required before process output.
- [ ] Cleanup and disposal plan confirmed.
